project: Project 2 — CAPM and Fama-French Factor Attribution

time_ordered_attribution_check.interpretation: descriptive coefficient stability and same-month attribution error after factor realizations; not preregistered, point-in-time, ex-ante, or a strategy test

units.asset_returns: decimal simple total return per month
units.published_factors: decimal factor spread per month; used unchanged
units.risk_free: decimal monthly Treasury-bill return proxy; subtracted from the asset return exactly once
units.coefficient_interpretation: one-unit monthly factor spread change; for example a 0.01 change in a factor maps to beta times 0.01 in the fitted monthly asset excess return

costs_and_execution.transaction_costs: not applicable: no signal, order, turnover, or trade ledger
costs_and_execution.financing_and_borrow: not applicable: no positions or financing/borrow ledger
